title: manifest.jsonl — PRS policy publication (Report Summaries, Vital Stats)
description: One item from a PRS Legislative Research policy publication listing. Report Summaries and Vital Stats are the same Drupal Views template, so they share one record shape and are told apart by `kind` and `surface`. PRS-derived records are internal-research-only and stamped source=prsindia.org for downstream segregation. `pdf_url` is null when PRS publishes the item with no download; that is a real state of the listing, not a parse failure, and the item is kept rather than dropped. A row whose PDF fetch failed carries status=error with the reason — a missing item and an undownloadable one are different facts, and only one of them is about PRS.

pdf_url.description: Absolute URL of the item's PDF, or null when the listing offers no download for it.

pdf_path.description: Corpus-relative path of the retained PDF; null unless --download was used.
